pairs: Canticum graduum David.
A Canticle in steps: of David.
Domine,
O Lord,
non est exaltatum cor meum,
my heart has not been exalted,
neque elati sunt oculi mei,
and my eyes have not been raised up.
neque ambulavi in magnis, neque in mirabilibus super me.
Neither have I walked in greatness, nor in wonders beyond me.
Si non humiliter sentiebam,
When I was not humble in thought,
sed exaltavi animam meam:
then I lifted up my soul.
sicut ablactatus est super matre sua,
Like one who has been weaned from his mother,
ita retributio in anima mea.
so was I recompensed in my soul.
Speret Israël in Domino,
Let Israel hope in the Lord,
ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
from this time forward and even forever.
